The prior of Student t errors

Source: R/add_priors_checks.R
student_t_prior.Rd

Checks sigma$student_t against the model and returns the prior the degrees of freedom are drawn under, or NULL for a model with normal errors.

Usage

student_t_prior(object, sigma)

Arguments

object

a model object whose model$student_t says whether its errors are Student t.

sigma

the list given to add_priors, whose element student_t is either list(df = ), holding the degrees of freedom fixed, or list(shape = , rate = ), the gamma prior of Juarez and Steel (2010) under which they are drawn.

Value

A named list of the prior, or NULL.

Details

Exported so that a package building its own models checks the prior the way add_priors does. Like every other hyperparameter it has no default, and a prior given to a model with normal errors is refused rather than ignored.

References

Juarez, M. A. and Steel, M. F. J. (2010). Model-based clustering of non-Gaussian panel data based on skew-t distributions. Journal of Business & Economic Statistics, 28(1), 52–66.
